sentences.text: He came home on the Thursday and asked his father, at the net, and this time he asked it properly.
He said: whose name did you say.
His father worked for a while.

Then he said: "The first year I did it I was twelve and I said your grandfather, and he was alive and well and standing on that bank about thirty metres behind me, and I remember thinking it was a waste of a turn." He put the shuttle down.
"I've said your mother's name most years.

I said yours the year you were born and the year you had the pneumonia and I have not said it since, and you can work out what that means about how I think you're getting on." Xuan said that he had been to the source.
He said there was nothing there.
He said that no salmon in history had ever got within twenty kilometres of it and that his father must have known that.
"Of course I knew that." "Then what is it *for*?" And his father said the thing that Xuan has been carrying around for twenty-two years and has never improved on.
He said: "You stood in a river, in front of the whole village, and you had four minutes, and you had to choose one person and it could not be you.
And you chose.

And then you said it out loud, in the open, with your mouth, which you have never done for any of those people on any other day of your life and you never will." Xuan started to say something about the fish.
"I know about the fish," his father said.

"I've known about the weirs since I was younger than you and I went up there myself when I was about nineteen, and I sat on the same rock, and I came home the same way you did with the same face on." He said that he had not told Xuan because being told is not the same as going, and because his own father had not told him.
He picked the net back up.
"The fish takes it up the river.
Maybe.
I don't know and neither does anybody.
But you *said* it, Xuan, and there's about eleven hundred people in this town and every one of them has said one, and that is what the river is for." Xuan is thirty-seven.
He goes every June.
He has said his father's name for the last nine years running, which his father is aware of, because Xuan told him once, in a car, and neither of them has mentioned it since.
